fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on landlords and rental rates, streetcar and traffic hazards, proposed traffic circle improvements, and concerns about transient traders. Contains items on Nassau/Bahamas tourism reciprocity and Miami-Bahamas travel, local "late news bulletins" (including resignations of justices of the peace and other incidents), and consumer-protection topics such as gasoline pump inspections and bank account fees. Also features Labor Day-related announcements and substantial promotional/feature content about Florida oil exploration and investment opportunities (including Meyer Oil Corporation and Cuban American Petroleum Corp.).
